stemMarkdown: Taking the day as a whole, profit was what percentage of revenue? Give the answer to two decimal places.
solutionMarkdown:
Profit line by line:

- Loaves: $5400 \times 0.40 = 2160$
- Cakes: $20000 \times 0.45 = 9000$
- Pastries: $6000 \times 0.60 = 3600$

$2160 + 9000 + 3600 = 14760$ on revenue of 31,400:

$\dfrac{14760}{31400} \times 100 = 47.01\%$

**47.01%**. Averaging the three margins (40%, 45%, 60%) gives 48.33% and is wrong: cakes carry nearly two-thirds of the revenue, so the overall margin sits close to the cake margin, not to the middle of the three.
